pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Watching the streams, chatting and collecting stamps is free. Only the New Year Pass is paid: $7 once, no subscription.
pricing.freeA: Everything that matters: live streams, the chat and country rooms, passport stamps, the schedule, the time zone map and country pages. There are no ads and no paid access to streams.
pricing.passQ: What does the New Year Pass include?
pricing.passA: A chat badge and your visible path, your own schedule with reminders, quiet chat mode, message translation and the “My New Years” card. The Pass is valid for New Year {season} — until 1 January {year}, 14:00 UTC.
pricing.onceA: No. $7 is a single payment in US dollars, taxes included. There are no automatic charges and nothing to cancel.
pricing.sellerA: Payments are processed by our authorised reseller (Merchant of Record); its name is shown on the checkout page and on your receipt. It acts as the seller and handles taxes; we never see your card details. You must be 18 or older to buy. Details are in the <terms>Terms</terms>.
pricing.refundQ: How do I get a refund?
pricing.refundA: Within 30 days of payment: no reason needed if you haven’t used the Pass, and a full refund if it didn’t work. Write to <mail>{email}</mail> — we reply within 3 business days. Details are in “<refunds>Payments & Refunds</refunds>”.
pricing.whenA: Sales open closer to the celebration. The Pass is sold only for the current New Year: it is not sold after the {season} celebration ends.

faq.londonQuestion: London: what time is New Year in my time?
faq.londonAnswer: London and the whole UTC+0 time zone welcome the New Year at 00:00 UTC.
faq.londonAnswerTimed: London and the whole UTC+0 time zone welcome the New Year at 00:00 UTC — that’s {time}.
faq.whyQuestion: Why do some countries celebrate at a different time?
faq.whyAnswer: The world is divided into time zones, and each has its own midnight. Some countries use an unusual offset — half an hour or 45 minutes — so their midnight doesn’t fall on the hour.

when.q: When is midnight in my time?
when.a: Midnight in this country arrives at {time} in your time. The countdown runs right on the page, so there’s no need to work it out yourself.

stamp.q: Will I get a stamp if there’s no stream?
stamp.a: Yes. The stamp is given for being on the country page at midnight, not for watching the video. A stream may appear later or not at all — the stamp will arrive either way.

switch.a: In the “Streams” section, tap the card you want and the player switches to it right away. Or press “Choose a stream” below the video.

room.q: Can I watch several streams at once?
room.a: Yes, in the viewing room. Press “+” on a stream card to add it as a new window. You can have up to four windows on a computer and up to two on a phone. Sound plays in only one.
